description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to deep copying (cloning) objects within the Orleans serialization framework. It includes interfaces for deep copiers, shallow copiers, and providers, as well as utility classes for managing copy contexts and shallow copyable types.

classes.name: ShallowCopier
classes.description: A singleton class implementing IOptionalDeepCopier that performs shallow copying by returning the input object directly.

classes.name: ShallowCopier<T>
classes.description: A generic class implementing IOptionalDeepCopier and IDeepCopier<T> that performs shallow copying by returning the input object.

classes.name: CopyContext
classes.description: A class managing the context during deep copy operations, including tracking already copied objects and providing deep copy functionality.

classes.name: CopyContextPool
classes.description: A class managing a pool of CopyContext instances for reuse, improving performance during multiple copy operations.

methods.name: TryGetCopy
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a previously recorded copy of an object from the context.

methods.name: RecordCopy
methods.description: Records a copy of an object in the context.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Clears the internal copy tracking dictionary.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a value of type T using the associated deep copier.

methods.name: Return
methods.description: Returns a CopyContext to the pool after resetting it.

methods.name: GetContext
methods.description: Retrieves a CopyContext from the pool.
